name: MiNini BeamNG Toolkit
description: Standalone BeamNG tools for wheel-load balance, debug-state persistence, mouse steering, spawn heading, and STM32 dashboard telemetry.

mods.title: Weight Balance
mods.description: Live FL/FR/RL/RR tire loads, total wheel load, and a circular front/rear and left/right balance display.

mods.title: Debug Memory
mods.description: Remembers vehicle debug visualizations, mesh visibility and debug spawn settings between game sessions.

mods.title: Mouse Steering Toggle
mods.description: Adds or removes direct Mouse X steering through BeamNG's normal input-binding system.

mods.title: Spawn Heading
mods.description: Turns marked vehicles 90 degrees right on spawn without changing their nodes or meshes.

mods.title: Dashboard Telemetry
mods.description: Sends the active player's vehicle data to AutoCraft Companion over localhost UDP for forwarding to an STM32 dashboard.
